# AMES Food Advisory

> Food safety consulting, HACCP plan development, SOP writing, staff training, and compliance auditing for NSW food businesses. Based in Sydney, Australia.

AMES Food Advisory is a specialist food safety consultancy founded by George Skarmoutsos — 11+ years in QA and food manufacturing at The Arnott's Group, TAE-qualified trainer, and TAFE NSW sessional lecturer in Food Science & Technology.

## Services

- [Food Safety & HACCP Consulting](/food-safety-consulting-sydney): HACCP plan development, food safety program design, hazard analysis, regulatory compliance gap analysis. Custom-built for your specific operation.
- [HACCP Plan Development](/haccp-plan-development): Full hazard analysis, CCP identification, critical limits, monitoring procedures, and verification systems.
- [Food Safety Training](/food-safety-training-sydney): On-site food safety and HACCP training delivered by a TAE-qualified trainer. Food handler competency, allergen management, supervisor training.
- [Internal Food Safety Auditing](/internal-auditing-services): Gap analysis, pre-audit readiness checks, mock inspections, corrective action support, and ongoing compliance monitoring.
- [SOP & Documentation Writing](/sop-writing-food-businesses): Custom standard operating procedures, monitoring forms, corrective action records, and audit-ready food safety documentation.
- [Food Business Start-Up Package](/food-business-startup-package): Complete compliance setup for new food businesses — council registration, HACCP plan, SOP suite, staff training, pre-inspection preparation.
- [Food Lab Skills Training](/lab-skills-training): Hands-on laboratory training — microbial plating, chemical testing, sensory panels, and data logging for QA teams.
- [RTO Resource Development](/rto-resource-development): Curriculum development, assessment tool design, competency mapping, and training resources for RTOs delivering food qualifications.
- [Online Food Safety Short Courses](/online-food-safety-courses): Self-paced professional development — HACCP fundamentals, allergen management, food safety programs (launching 2026).
- [Food Sampling & Inspection Services](/sampling-inspection-services): Product sampling program design, incoming goods inspection, shelf-life testing liaison, sensory evaluation support.

## Client Types

- [Small Food Businesses](/food-safety-small-business): Practical compliance, record-keeping setup, and training for small operations.
- [Food Startups](/food-startup-consultant-sydney): Strategic compliance advising, kitchen design review, label validation, HACCP programs before launch.
- [Cafes & Restaurants](/cafe-restaurant-food-safety): Food safety programs, kitchen inspections, allergen management, staff training for hospitality.
- [Food Manufacturers](/food-manufacturer-consulting): Advanced QA programs, GFSI audit preparation (SQF, BRC), supplier risk management.
- [RTOs & Training Providers](/rto-food-technology-resources): Curriculum updates, assessment tools, learner guides for food qualifications.
- [Food Industry Workers](/food-industry-workers-training): GMP training, CCP monitoring, allergen controls, record-keeping for production staff.
